notes.title: Update from the Depths – the demo has more content!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735712/c6b98333d5799aac5817f2c802260cc6e0c4cde8.png"]



Greetings, Well Dwellers!
Unwell has just received a powerful injection of fixes and improvements!
Improvements
During the alarm cycle, hiding in a locker will no longer cancel the alarm, but you can still feel relatively safe there. Or… maybe it’s better to go hunting for items?

The hostile creatures in the well have grown even smarter. Sometimes it will already be too late to escape.

Many more events are now included in the save system, so you won’t need to repeat them.

Movement physics have been polished again – guiding the protagonist through his descent should feel smoother.

New Points of Interest have been added – it’ll be harder to miss certain events now.

The Fear mechanic has been reworked. The protagonist now needs to stare at a threat for longer before starting to lose it.

Sounds have been added for weapon crafting and weapon breaking.

Additional sounds have been added for hiding.

Creature sounds have been expanded.

The in-game cursor should now properly stay within the game window.

Fullscreen interactions have been improved – spoken text should remain on screen while choosing responses.

The alarm warning has been improved and is now more visible.

The lantern has received a serious boost!
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where after a weapon broke, the remaining ones would stop working.

Improved the save manager so that the protagonist’s progress is properly saved in certain situations.

Restored item pickup sounds.

Adjusted items lying on maps so they’re easier to pick up.

More levels are joining internal testing – will you find the courage to try them out?
Join our Discord and let us know! :)


Thank you for standing against the gray with us. 
— Head Protégé


Anaesthetic Discord!

notes.title: Update from the Depths — The Demo has more content!
notes.content:
Hello, fellow well-dwellers.

Unwell demo just got... deeper.

New Content  
  
 Expanded exploration in the Pride level – more paths to take and more room to outsmart enemies.  
 Additional items in the Pride level to help you hold your ground.  
 More hiding spots – use them strategically!  
 Improved visibility: more walls are now transparent in tight areas.  
 New encounters and events across all demo levels.  
 Fresh points of interest waiting to be discovered :)  
  

Improvements  
 Brand-new animations!  
 Several existing animations have been polished and refined :)  
 Overhauled protagonist animation logic for smoother gameplay.  
 Upgraded inventory fonts for better readability.  
 High-step stairs are easier to climb now.  
 Enhanced models with improved details.  

Bug Fixes  
 Fixed an issue where some items displayed a condition meter unnecessarily.  
 Defeated monsters no longer block your path.  

Thank you for standing against The Gray with us. 
— Head Protégé

notes.title: Update from the Abyss: The Protagonist Gains Momentum!
notes.content:
Hello, fellow well dwellers.

We know you're waiting for version 1.0, but we haven't forgotten about the current content! We've just introduced several important fixes and improvements.

What's new?
Improved movement physics – moving our protagonist is now smoother and more intuitive.

Revised UI – UI elements now appear and disappear exactly when they should, providing a better gameplay experience.

Collision bug fixes – we've removed a few spots where you could unexpectedly fall through the floor. The well can be treacherous, but not that much!

Linux fix – the game should now launch without any issues on Linux systems. Let us know if you're playing on Proton—we've heard it's working great there too!

Thank you for standing against the gray with us.

— Head Protégé

notes.title: Update from the Depths — The Demo Expands!
notes.content:
Hello, fellow well-dwellers.

Our demo just got... deeper.

From now on, you can get a closer look at certain places. A new camera system allows you to explore selected areas more intimately — give it a try and see what may have slipped your eyes before.

Interactions have been refreshed: new icons, better feedback, and clearer ways to engage with the world inside the well.

Our protagonist now moves with new grace — improved animations and better responsiveness make traversing this reality more organic than ever.

Weapon logic has been completely reworked, adding new tactical depth to how you approach encounters with less-than-friendly inhabitants of the well.

Development of Unwell 1.0 is progressing steadily — we’ve just started producing the eighth level of the well. Only one more to go...

Thank you for standing against the gray with us.

— Head Protégé

notes.title: Unwell release date anoucement!
notes.content:
Welcome, friendly Well-dwellers!

We’ve worked hard for this – and we can finally announce it!

Thanks to the data from our task system, we can now officially reveal the release date for Unwell! The game will launch on September 29, 2026. We are incredibly excited as we look at the action plan we’ve prepared – and we’re not slowing down.

The full version of the game will consist of nine levels, each inspired by the corresponding level of Dr. Hawkins’ Map of Consciousness, with a story based on Dr. Freud’s theory of personality. We estimate around 13 hours for a single playthrough, with three different endings!

But that’s not all! Along with announcing the release date, we’re dropping a massive update for the demo version. You can now see the direction Unwell is heading by exploring the abyss of the human psyche in about an hour of content covering the first three levels of the Well!

Want to get to know us better? See playable content we haven’t shared yet?

Join our Discord!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735712/7e884b81306c7635ea7822d5fe9ab29fff28ab0b.png

Thank you for standing against the gray with us.

— Head Protégé

notes.title: ✨ Unwell demo Update – Huge Changes and New Features! ✨
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735712/1962f3190c145807be85a58b403c45be52d29e5b.png

What’s happening?

Hey Patients! 🖤 It’s time for a fresh dose of Unwell updates! We’ve introduced tons of fixes, improvements, and brand-new mechanics to immerse you even more in the game’s world. Here’s what’s coming:

🔧Fixes and Optimizations

 Lots of performance optimizations – more fixes are on the way!
 Improved sound design to help you better understand what’s happening around you.
 Slightly faster weapon wind-up for smoother combat.
 Protagonist animation overhaul!
 Improved item pickup logic – you can no longer pick up items through walls.

⚔️ Combat and Movement Mechanics

 Dodge with iFrames – now dodging grants temporary invincibility!
 New pushback logic – instead of changing the player’s position, it applies a physical force to prevent clipping through walls.
 New lighter mechanic – don’t keep it lit for too long, or you’ll regret it…
 Stamina overhaul – movement and dodging are now more strategic.

💡 World and Exploration

 Complete lighting overhaul – every level now looks more atmospheric.
 New storage mechanic – too many items? Store them in a desk and come back for them later!
 The world is becoming more alive – you’ll encounter more than just enemies.
 Out of bounds fixes – no more accidental map exits.

👻 Hostile Well Dwellers

 Overhaul of all hostile well dwellers!
 A new type of enemy! 👀
 Interactions are now interrupted if you get attacked by an enemy.
 Hugging well dweller received new physics and logic improvements.

🌌 Dream Sequences & Puzzles

 Overhauled dream section – now more polished and mysterious.
 Reworked animations for the level 2 puzzle.
 Added a tutorial prompt – use the crowbar on the well and see what happens next.

🎥 Cinematics & Interactions

 Death cutscenes can now be skipped – regain control faster!
 Model improvements, especially for pickup items.
 Enhanced interactions in dream sequences.


And this is just the beginning! We’re working hard on even more changes and new features. Thank you for your support and feedback – you’re the best patients we could ever wish for! 🖤

See you in the darkest corners of the well!

Your Anaesthetic Studio Team 🩸🕯️

Join us on Discord!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735712/7e884b81306c7635ea7822d5fe9ab29fff28ab0b.png

Thank you for standing against The Gray with us.

— Head Protégé

notes.title: Unwell 34th Update!
notes.content:
Demo Unwell receives its 34th update on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2662070/Unwell/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735712/e3eebb8865d0e61edb26371b57721f2c6ad120b9.png

Overview of key changes in the updated version:

FIXES/IMPROVEMENTS

 In addition to WASD, you can now also move using the arrow keys on the keyboard, if you prefer.
 The transition between the first and second levels has been improved, and the protagonist should no longer trip over thin air.
 The shader responsible for hiding/revealing objects in the protagonist's field of view has been improved—it's even nicer now!
 Various game details have been enhanced.
 The partial vision in darkness mechanic has received a major update, and we hope it will stop acting up.
 Many textures have been improved.
 The second level has received a few changes to highlight important areas.


What's next?

We're now working on the third level and improving the overall game :)
The second type of less friendly well-dweller is getting closer!
With the next update, the game will also be playable on Linux!

 Join us on Discord! 

Thank you for standing with us against the Gray.

Head Protégé

Overview of key changes in the updated version:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735712/6ee37f1bb8a40aa97fa1d0e07642aa8670a036ff.png

CONTENT

 A few interesting events have appeared :) stay vigilant.
 The boards have received a material refresh for the new shader supporting partial vision. Be careful, because from today nothing in the well is as it may seem.
 Taking damage has more consequences than it might seem.


FIXES/IMPROVEMENTS

 The field of view has received some interesting tweaks :)
 The protagonist's fear might become quite apparent... nevertheless, you can take advantage of it.
 We took away the protagonist's rollerblades, which he occasionally liked to activate while picking up items.


What's next?

We're currently working on the third board and improving the overall game :)

Psssst... we also uploaded a Linux version, but we're a bit afraid of it. Do you have the courage to test it? Find us on Discord and ask for a key, but you're doing it at your own risk.

Thank you for standing with us against the Grey.

Head Protégé

notes.title: Anaesthetic Anniversary Party + Unwell 19th Update :)
notes.content:
Hello, fellow well dwellers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735712/905bcca7e2d6c2d3763aabdce3424286b08c7ce6.png

The Anaesthetic team celebrated its anniversary on 25.04 at Cybermachina Wroclaw game pub, co-organized with Korbank! We had a great time with people testing Unwell, engaging in productive conversations, and enjoying our very own drinks prepared by skilled bartenders :)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735712/8432d143ff6171cde37794daa6322510978c0002.jpg
We gained plenty of insight from our testers and are preparing changes to the Unwell world accordingly!

In the meantime, we've prepared a couple of hot fixes for the demo of Unwell :)

TWEAKS/FIXES:

Resolved issue with being stuck in the falling animation in some cases.

Resolved some out-of-bounds issues.

Optimized dodge mechanic.

Made entry to level 2 more accessible.

Enhanced durability of adversaries in level 2 (you're welcome!).

Addressed incorrect quickslot numbering in the inventory - we've reworked the logic behind it, but it still needs more refinement ;)

Updated descriptions of some objects, revealing a bit more of the game's lore.

More changes to item icons.

Thank you for standing against The Gray with us.

The Head Protege"

notes.title: Unwell 15th update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735712/ec6f48d249e658941216d415a237fce6bf628f78.png

Unwell Demo received its 15th update on Steam 🙂

Breakdown of the key changes in the updated version:

CONTENT

- The key to find in level 2 is now more visible and interactive. It will be easier to deduce what to do.
- The in-game menu now has settings where you can change graphics quality on the fly 🙂
- The in-game menu now has a controls review option.
- Quickslots now save along with your progress, so you won't need to reassign them with every death. Quality of life improvement! 😀

TWEAKS/FIXES

- The fall damage animation logic has been reworked to be played properly every time. Falling hurts the protagonist, and we do not recommend doing this anyway.
- Entering and exiting the inventory is faster now, another quality of life improvement! 😀
- Observation logic has been reworked slightly, allowing you to interact with more items in the scene 🙂
- Field Of Vision has been tweaked so you can see more, whether you want it or not.
- Protagonist item combination comments have been moved to a place where they can actually be read.
- Combination logic has been reworked. For instance, you can now fill the lamp with more oil refills at once 🙂
- Quality settings are now bug-free. At least we hope so 😉
- Some typos in letters and object descriptions have been fixed.
- Protagonist running/walking/landing sounds have had their logic changed, so now you will be able to hear all the commotion you make. We strongly advise against it.
- Unread notes in the inventory are more conspicuous. Please read them.
- The crowbar in level 1 is now more visible.

With every passing day, we are closer to updating the game with level 3. If you would like to check it out, reach out to us and ask for a special code to see what the level will be all about 🙂

Thank you for standing against The Gray at our side.
The Head Protege

notes.title: Unwell sixth update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735712/bd97a08e687f7751e9e7a9af991081f5698cc1a5.png

Unwell received its sixth update on Steam 🙂

Breakdown of the key changes in the updated version:

CONTENT

There are more ways to reflect the level of your sanity, so you better keep it up :)

TWEAKS/FIXES

Some textures and materials received a slight upgrade.

The third level is in development and will soon be available for you to descend into. It is ~15 times bigger than level 2, and for now, it contains 9 additional locations with puzzles to solve. This might be tricky, as more inhabitants of the well will get annoyed by your presence.

This level will reflect the idea of how complicated levels should Unwell contain, which means that the second level that you already know will get its content upgrade soon too!

Where are we in development of level3? The main structure of the level is done and 90% of its details are there to. It is time to sit back to the code and develop mysteries for you to unravel :) 

Here are some development screenshots for you to check out!

notes.title: Unwell third update!
notes.content:
Unwell received its third update on Steam :)

Breakdown of the key changes in the updated version:

CONTENT

- added particles while sprinting on wood, steel and wet surfaces. So you know what a fuss you're making. Some entities do not like that. 
- added feedback to the player about current health status with additional heart beat sound and increasing the volume of a heartbeat.
- added fall to death animation.
- added an animation for sitting on the ground and standing up after game load. So you will know that protagonist missed you. 
- changed the description of human remains in second level to remark the iron bar.
- added sound for landing in safe spot.
- added protagonist comment about safe landing.
- added missing footsteps sounds, and missing particles systems for landing and hard landing.
- added a mechanic to remember which notes have been readed in inventory and saving it in  game save.

TWEAKS/FIXES

- lowered the limit of water particles of the waterfalls for saving resources.
- changed the logic of enemies in Pride level to actualy turn to the player while chasing.
- resolved bug where player was supposed to be seen by mob1, but was not.
- resolved inconsequence of falldamage animation.
- resolved an issue with stones were wrong stone was picked up on click. That made a feel that they are doubling. 
- pickup script has been simplified for optimalization purposes.
- resolved issue with screen fade in and out not playing correctly when loading and saving the game.
- removed damage feedback from landing on a safe spot;
- made further adjustments to the animation controller of the protagonist. More to come.
- added a simple body freeze for not letting protagonist slide when hard landed on a steep surface.
- made eye symbols more visible.
- hopefully resolved issue with missing items in inventory on game load.



Thank you for standing against The Gray at our side.
The Main Protege"

notes.title: Unwell second update!
notes.content:
Unwell received its second update on Steam :)

Breakdown of the key changes in the updated version:

CONTENT

- Added waterfalls to the game.
- Added plenty of details to the levels with additional interactable content.
- Added light to the end of level 1 broken bridge for better navigation.
- Added a mechanic to drain health if the player stays in the dark for too long.
- Added a safe landing spot mechanic for the intended road to progress.
- Added a method to update health in the inventory, along with protagonist commentary!

TWEAKS/FIXES

- Resolved some description overlap at the beginning of level 1.
- Reworked one of the collapsing platforms for a better feel :)
- Adjusted the fall damage logic to match the animation.
- Moved grounded and fall logic to fixed update to make them independent of frames.
- Added a speed limit to prevent the player from sliding down stairs too quickly.
- Removed an additional grounding check that became redundant due to previous adjustments.
- Increased the volume of protagonist landing sounds.
- Added colliders to prevent the protagonist from walking beyond the bounds of the level.
- Resolved an issue with inventory item descriptions doubling after exiting the inventory.
- Adjusted player character variables responsible for physics and movement for a more realistic feel. No more Sonic speed!
- Resolved an issue with death animations being played incorrectly and at a low framerate.
- Added a ledge near the safe spot on level 2 to prevent annoying deaths due to an inability to see a hole.
- Added additional colliders to some bridges to help you navigate the area. Invisible little helpers are there <3
- Added blocking colliders to prevent speedrunning. Sorry, speedrunners, maybe next time... ;)
- Made the enemies more perceptive and responsive. You have been warned.


Thank you for standing against The Gray at our side.
The Main Protege"

notes.title: Unwell first update!
notes.content:
Unwell got it's first update on Steam :) 

Breakdown of the key changes in  updated version:

CONTENT

- added tutorial note from a stranger to the protagonist journal, to explain the basics  of inventory usage.

- added a prompt to use crowbar in certain situation.

- implemented a feature to detect imminent protagonist death. If the inventory screen is active at that critical moment, it now automatically gets disabled, so at least you will know what killed you. 

- added a check for enemy detection. If an enemy spots the player while the inventory is open, the inventory screen will now be promptly disabled. Run.

TWEAKS/FIXES

- adjusted the colliders at the exit point to Level 1 well, making it easier for you to jump into. 

- made additional configurations to the animator, refining character animations for a more polished and responsive gaming experience.

- resolved the issue of staying in a loop fall, ensuring that the game progression remains smooth and free from unintended glitches. So if noone memed it, it's too late.

- fall damage no longer postpones in midair, providing a more realistic and responsive outcome to your character's descent.

- optimized default landing mechanics, eliminating any midair postponements. Protagonist landing now aligns better with the laws of physics.

Thank you for standing against The Gray at our side.
The Main Protege
